standard.summary: 已有 YOLO 数据集配置文件时填这里。留空则由「训练目录 + 类别名」现场生成一份临时 yaml，训练结束后删除。
standard.effect: 只接受 .yaml / .yml 单文件；填了它就不再读训练目录与类别名，两条路互斥。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集已经按 YOLO 目录规范准备好、并且已有 data.yaml 时。
standard.avoidWhen: 类别名还没定、或图片目录还在调整时——手写 yaml 里写死的 train/val 路径不会跟着变。

standard_en.summary: Use this when you already have a YOLO dataset config file. Left empty, the run builds a temporary yaml from the train directory plus class names and deletes it afterwards.
standard_en.effect: Only a single .yaml / .yml file is accepted; once filled, the train directory and class names are not read, so the two inputs are mutually exclusive.
standard_en.whenToUse: When the dataset is already laid out in YOLO structure and a data.yaml exists.
standard_en.avoidWhen: While class names or image directories are still changing -- train/val paths hard-coded in a hand-written yaml will not follow.

advanced.principle: /api/yolo/train 按 data → dataset_yaml → dataset → dataset_path → yolo_data_config_path 的优先级取显式路径，用 validate_read_path 限制扩展名；都没有时才读 train_data_dir / val_data_dir / class_names 拼出 yaml，写进临时文件并登记到清理清单。entry_yolo 只认最终的 data 字段。
advanced.intervention: 路由层归一化请求；worker 侧拿到的永远是可直接交给 ultralytics 的路径。
advanced.expectedImpact: 无额外开销；显式 yaml 省掉一次临时文件写入与清理。
advanced.tradeoffs: UI 字段叫 dataset_yaml，worker 参数叫 data，中间那层归一化是唯一的桥。改字段名要同时改路由。

advanced_en.principle: /api/yolo/train resolves the explicit path in the order data -> dataset_yaml -> dataset -> dataset_path -> yolo_data_config_path and constrains the extension with validate_read_path; only when all are absent does it read train_data_dir / val_data_dir / class_names to assemble a yaml, write it to a temp file and register it for cleanup. entry_yolo only knows the final data field.
advanced_en.intervention: The router normalises the request, so the worker always receives a path ultralytics can consume directly.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: No extra cost; an explicit yaml saves one temp write and its cleanup.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The UI field is dataset_yaml while the worker parameter is data; that normalisation layer is the only bridge, so renaming the field means changing the router too.
